name: Toe Dips
pose: lies supine on the carriage with the back of her head on the headrest and her shoulders against the shoulder blocks, arms long by her sides with palms pressing lightly into the carriage. Both legs are lifted in a tabletop, hips and knees bent at 90 degrees and shins parallel to the carriage. One leg stays still in tabletop while the other lowers from the hip with the knee still bent, so its toes dip down to lightly touch the carriage. Her pelvis is neutral and still and her lower back rests flat on the carriage. She holds no straps and her feet do not touch the footbar.
highlight: the lower abdominals below the navel, with the hip flexors at the front of the lowering leg

name: Arms in Straps: Triceps Press
pose: lies supine on the carriage with the back of her head on the headrest, both legs lifted in a tabletop with knees bent at 90 degrees. She holds a strap handle in each hand with her upper arms resting on the carriage tight against her sides and her elbows bent to 90 degrees, so her forearms point straight up to the ceiling. She straightens both elbows to press the handles down beside her hips while her upper arms stay pinned to the carriage. Both straps run in a straight taut line from her hands back over her head to the pulleys at the head end.
highlight: the triceps at the back of both upper arms, with the abdominals holding the tabletop

name: Arms in Straps: T Press
pose: lies supine on the carriage with the back of her head on the headrest, both legs lifted in a tabletop with knees bent at 90 degrees. She holds a strap handle in each hand with both arms straight, opened wide out to the sides at shoulder height in a T just above the carriage, and sweeps both straight arms down in a wide arc to finish beside her hips. Show her mid-sweep: arms straight, angled about 45 degrees away from her body, hands just above the level of the carriage, palms facing down. Both straps run in a taut line from her hands back to the pulleys at the head end. Her shoulders stay down and her ribs stay soft.
highlight: the chest muscles and the latissimus dorsi along the sides of the back, with the abdominals holding the tabletop

name: Reformer Standing Lunge
pose: stands in a deep lunge along the length of the reformer. Her front foot is flat on the fixed wooden platform with the front knee bent to about 90 degrees directly over the ankle. Her back leg reaches long behind her with the ball of the back foot on the carriage, pressed against the shoulder block, so the carriage has slid away from the platform under her back foot. Her torso is upright, her pelvis square to the front, and one hand rests lightly on the footbar or frame for balance while the other rests on her hip.
highlight: the glutes and quadriceps of the bent front leg, with the hamstrings of the front leg and the hip flexors at the front of the long back leg

name: Mermaid
pose: sits side-on on the carriage with her legs folded to one side in a relaxed Z-sit, her near hand resting on the footbar with that arm straight. The carriage has slid away from the footbar, so her torso leans into a long side bend toward the bar while her other arm reaches up and over her head in a long curve, making a crescent-moon shape through her side waist and ribs. Both sitting bones stay heavy on the carriage and her head follows the line of her spine.
highlight: the obliques and quadratus lumborum along the lengthened side of her waist, with the latissimus dorsi of the overhead arm

name: Reverse Frog Kicks
apparatus: the long box (a long padded rectangular box sitting lengthways on top of the carriage, which she lies face down on) and one black strap looped around the arch of her working foot, running back to the pulleys at the head end. Both must be clearly visible, and she must be in correct physical contact with them.
pose: lies face down on the long box with her head toward the footbar and her legs toward the pulleys, resting on her forearms with her chest low and her neck long. One foot is in a strap loop: that knee is bent and turned out to the side in a frog shape with the heel drawn toward her seat, then she presses the leg long and straight behind her against the strap. Her other leg lies long and still on the box, and both hip bones stay pressed into the box.
highlight: the glutes and deep hip rotators of the working leg, with the hamstrings of that leg

name: Longbox Hip Stretch
pose: stands on the floor at the foot end of the reformer facing along it, with her front foot flat on top of the long box so that front knee bends to about 90 degrees. Her back leg reaches long behind her on the floor with the heel lifted and the knee straight. Her hips sink forward and down, square to the front, her torso is upright and both hands rest on her front thigh.
highlight: the hip flexors and the front of the thigh of the long back leg, gently lengthening, with the glutes of the front leg

name: Longbox Hamstring Stretch
pose: stands on the floor at the foot end of the reformer facing along it, with the heel of one straight leg resting on top of the long box and the toes pointing up to the ceiling. Her standing leg is straight beneath her and her hips are square. She hinges forward from the hips over the raised leg with a long, flat spine, both hands resting lightly on the shin of the raised leg, neck long.
highlight: the hamstrings at the back of the raised leg, gently lengthening, with the calf of that leg

name: Longbox Shoulder Stretch
pose: stands on the floor at the foot end of the reformer facing along it, feet hip-width apart, with both hands placed flat on top of the long box. She has walked her feet back and hinged at the hips so her torso is level with the floor, arms straight and in line with her ears, and her chest sinks gently down between her arms. Her hips stack over her heels and her knees are soft.
highlight: the latissimus dorsi and the backs of both shoulders, gently lengthening, with the chest muscles

name: Butterfly Stretch
apparatus: the sliding teal carriage, which she lies on, and two black straps looped around her feet, running back to the pulleys at the head end. Both must be clearly visible, and she must be in correct physical contact with them.
pose: lies supine on the carriage with the back of her head on the headrest and her arms resting by her sides. Both feet are in the strap loops with the soles pressed together and the knees bent and dropping wide open to the sides in a relaxed diamond, the feet held up at about knee height by the straps. Her pelvis is heavy and still on the carriage and her whole body looks relaxed.
highlight: the inner-thigh adductors of both legs, gently lengthening
